name: harness
description: Start coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and more) the person can watch and read.
long_description:
Harness runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and other engines) in sessions of their own, on this computer or the person's other machines. The person can watch and join every one in the Harness app. With this extension, Claude can start harnesses, wait for them, read their answers and close them.

**It needs the Harness CLI** (macOS or Linux):

```
curl -fsSL https://harness.autonomous.ai/cli/install.sh | bash
harness start
```

On Linux the installer installs tmux and curl with apt-get, which asks for your password.

No account is needed for harnesses on this computer. Until the CLI is installed, the extension offers one tool, `harness_setup`, that says how to install it.

Claude may give work to, and close, only the harnesses it started. The rest are the person's.

tools.name: harness_whoami
tools.description: Who you are to Harness: which agent, on which machine, whether you may start harnesses now and who can change that, and how much of your limit is left.

tools.name: harness_list
tools.description: The harnesses on this machine: name, agent, state, who started each, when it was last active, its folder, and what it is about.

tools.name: harness_search
tools.description: Search the conversations on this computer for the words that say them: every turn of every harness, live or stopped.

tools.name: harness_machines
tools.description: The machines on this account: name, status, and which is this one, to run a harness on another of the person's machines.

tools.name: harness_start
tools.description: Start a new harness: an agent (claude, codex, opencode, pi, …) in a session of its own, working on a task in a new project Harness makes and owns (no approval) or in an existing folder (the engine asks the person to trust it). Prefer project.

tools.name: harness_wait
tools.description: Wait until harnesses stop working, then say each one's state.

tools.name: harness_read
tools.description: A harness's state and its last turn: what it was asked and what it answered.

tools.name: harness_tell
tools.description: Give more work to a harness you started, on any machine, in the conversation it already has. Only while the person allows it.

tools.name: harness_settings
tools.description: What agents may do here, the person's settings: each one and whether it is on, or turn one on (once the person says yes) or off.

tools.name: harness_close
tools.description: Close a harness you started, once it is done. Its conversation is kept: the person can resume it.
